title: Require Pinned E2 oRPC Error Authority
forbids: direct ORPCError construction, toORPCError acquisition, middleware-owned .errors maps, runtime error imports in executable interiors, ORPCTaggedError declarations outside contract leaves or model/errors, or custom translation portals
why: Pinned effect-orpc 0.5.0 maps contract-declared ORPCTaggedError failures. A catch-all ORPCError bridge would duplicate provider authority and erase declared failure semantics.
remediate: Declare leaf-local public ORPCTaggedError values in the owning contract, or place genuinely shared error vocabulary under model/errors; attach the map at that contract and use injected errors.* constructors or yield declared tagged failures.
message: Public service errors must flow through pinned effect-orpc contract authority.
